name: Mikayla Demaiter career
content: Mikayla Demaiter's career highlights: Goaltender for the Bluewater Hawks (PWHL Jr); retired at 19 after knee surgery in 2019; Rebuilt as a multimillion-follower glam model dubbed 'the world's sexiest hockey player'; Modeled for Pretty Little Thing and Fashion Nova

name: Mikayla Demaiter personal
content: About Mikayla Demaiter: Born May 14, 2000 in Chatham, Ontario, Canada; graduated from the University of Western Ontario (BA, 2022). Linked publicly to NHL player Kurtis Gabriel and later to golfer Bryson DeChambeau.

name: Mikayla Demaiter quotes
content: Things Mikayla Demaiter has said: Everyone asks me why i chose to be a goalie, and the answer is simple - there's nothing i love more than being number one.

name: Mikayla Demaiter voice
content: Mikayla Demaiter's speaking style: Bold, playful, hockey-girl swagger. Competitive one-liners in captions, e.g. on being a goalie: 'there's nothing I love more than being number one.'
